title.value: Assessing the Quality of Direct-to-Consumer Teleconsultation Services in Canada
title.justification: The title reflects the main focus and subject of the paper, which is to assess the quality of teleconsultation services in Canada.
title.quote: "The objective of this study was to describe and assess the quality of the direct-to-consumer medical teleconsultation landscape in three Canadian provinces."

extractions.description: The study describes and evaluates the quality of direct-to-consumer medical teleconsultation platforms across Quebec, Ontario, and British Columbia, using a modified version of the HONcode principles. The paper examines the heterogeneity in the quality of these platforms and how they integrate with Canada's universal healthcare system.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on assessing medical teleconsultation services rather than addressing climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: "The objective of this study was to describe and assess the quality of the direct-to-consumer medical teleconsultation landscape in three Canadian provinces."

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes.
primary_category.quote: "The quality of each teleconsultation platform was assessed using a modified version of the HONcode principles."

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no sub-category that aligns with the themes of the paper, which focuses on healthcare teleconsultation.
primary_sub_category.quote: "The landscape of virtual primary care is changing rapidly in the Canadian ecosystem."

new_primary_category.justification: The paper explores the integration of technology in the healthcare sector, particularly focusing on teleconsultation services.
new_primary_category.quote: "The objective of this study was to describe and assess the quality of the direct-to-consumer medical teleconsultation landscape in three Canadian provinces."
